question: Which of the following countries is located to the southeast of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sri Lanka** is located to the **southeast of India**. It is an island country situated in the Indian Ocean.
 
• It is separated from mainland India by the **Palk Strait** and the **Gulf of Mannar**. Geographically, it lies below the southern tip of India.
 
• **Sri Lanka** is closest to the Indian state of **Tamil Nadu**, making it a neighboring country that is southeast of India. *Hence, Sri Lanka is the correct answer.*
 
• The other options like **China**, **Bhutan**, and **Nepal** are located to the north or northeast of India, making them incorrect answers.
 
• To the north of India lies **Nepal** and **Bhutan**, while **China** is situated further northeast. These countries are not in the southeast direction from India. *Hence, only Sri Lanka is southeast of India.*

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sri Lanka:**

 
 
• **Sri Lanka** is an island nation located in the **Indian Ocean**. It is officially known as the **Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka**.
 
• It has a rich cultural heritage, with influences from both **India** and other Asian nations. The capital city is **Colombo**, and its administrative capital is **Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte**.
 
• **Geography:** Sri Lanka is separated from India by the **Palk Strait**. The **Adam’s Bridge**, also known as the Ram Setu, is a chain of limestone shoals connecting India and Sri Lanka.
 
 
 
• **Other Countries Mentioned:**
 
 
• **China:** Located to the northeast of India, China shares borders with Indian states like **Arunachal Pradesh, Sikkim, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh**, and **Ladakh**.
 
• **Bhutan:** Bhutan is a landlocked country situated in the Himalayas and lies to the north of India. It shares borders with **Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh, West Bengal**, and **Assam**.
 
• **Nepal:** Nepal is another landlocked country located to the north of India. It shares borders with Indian states like **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar**, and **Sikkim**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Geographical Features of Sri Lanka:**

 
 
• **Area:** Sri Lanka covers an area of approximately **65,610 square kilometers**.
 
• **Climate:** It has a tropical climate with distinct wet and dry seasons influenced by monsoons.
 
• **Economy:** Sri Lanka’s economy is largely dependent on **agriculture, tourism**, and the export of goods like tea, rubber, and textiles.
 
 
 
• **Historical and Cultural Importance:**
 
 
• **Historical Ties:** Sri Lanka shares cultural and historical ties with India, particularly in terms of **Buddhism** and ancient trade routes.
 
• **Ramayana Connection:** According to Indian mythology, Sri Lanka is considered the kingdom of **Lanka**, ruled by **Ravana** in the epic Ramayana.
